page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results show top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 10%. Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores are strong, ranking in the top 25%, which is also reflected in strong image and text processing capabilities. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth (99.54 GB/sec read and 56.0 GB/sec write for large uncached blocks), and database operations perform at average levels. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 (VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, making it a reliable choice for production environments. However, the lack of local storage means all disk I/O must go over the network, which may impact highly storage-intensive workloads. Given its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio and strong single-core capabilities, this instance is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, application servers, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
